description_complementaire: Aggregate max on total solar-all MW at node BEWAL, incl. existing capacity (solving.agg_p_nom_limits.include_existing = true).
note_complementaire: 2025 base year, min = max, so the base year is a calibration and not an optimisation. Value is the model's own historical fleet (powerplantmatching + data/custom_powerplants.csv, plus the committed extendable floor). Without it the model built 4796 MW of Walloon onshore wind in a single year. See docs/renewable-potentials.md section 5.

description_complementaire: Aggregate min on total onwind MW at node BEWAL, incl. existing capacity (solving.agg_p_nom_limits.include_existing = true).
note_complementaire: 2030 floor (3000 MW) DROPPED for the realistic-potential scenarios. ICEDD's scen_realiste.csv caps 2030 Walloon onwind at 2203 MW and solar-all at 3474 MW, both BELOW the central floors (3000 / 6500 MW), so keeping the floor would make the 2030 corridor empty (min > max). ICEDD dropped these rows from the master table in ee19e962; the central scenario keeps them (the projects behind them are in the pipeline), so the drop is scoped to this scenario instead.
